_anonymised_copy: Anonymised copy of a registered protocol file: internal provenance fields (storage ids, hosts, resource accounting, internal review notes) were removed or redacted. Embedded sha256 values refer to the original registered file and do not match this copy.
plan: Research-track plan (registered 2026-11-17), steps 'Register structural ablation design', 'Replay Parser-alone vs Parser-plus-alternatives', 'Retrain Ranker without each feature group'. PAKDD 2027 research-track paper 'Data-Efficient TKGQA via Structural Guidance and Symbolic Execution'. Protocol: tkg-claims-protocol.

question.A: On the MultiTQ test split, how much of the Parser arm's (P_k) Hits@1 comes from the deduplicated structural alternatives that follow the Parser hypothesis, i.e. how does executing ONLY the Parser hypothesis (PALONE_k) compare with P_k at k = 1/5/10/100%, under the same fallback handling, and without any fallback?
question.B: At k = 1% and 5%, which of six disjoint groups of the Ranker's 34 features does the Ranker need: how much test Hits@1 is lost when the LightGBM lambdarank Ranker is retrained without each group, against a full-feature Ranker retrained by the same procedure in the same run?

nature: POST-HOC structural analyses. Part A replays FROZEN cached parser generations through the FROZEN executor and Ranker models (no LLM inference, no training, no selection). Part B trains NEW Ranker versions (full and ablated) with the frozen recipe and dev_sel2000-only selection. Neither part changes any registered result (KP1-KP4 of multitq_kpct_decision_rule.json, robustness R1/R2 outcomes) or any frozen file.
test_split_label: REUSE of the official MultiTQ test split (questions/test.json, 54,584 questions, sha256 d9bf3bf23b489ecc76c7940510c718260a42350d934a6edc1c1c7efcd5238fee), already scored once in the k% single test pass (2026-10-28T01:11:37Z) and in the robustness probes R1/R2. Every number of this track is labelled 'test split reused'. Nothing is selected on test.

status_at_registration.new_outputs: None scored. No ablated or retrained Ranker exists; no PALONE / PREL / PENT prediction file exists for the full test split or the rewrites; no gold answer has been read for any output of this track.
work_before_registration: Read the frozen code (pk_execute.py, pk_common.py, kpct_executor.py, kpct_core.py, mtq_cand.py, kpct_run.py, kpct_retrain_fixed_vocab.py, rob_build.py) and the reproduction notes REPRODUCE_kpct.md.

Built a local copy of the executor tree from the archived k% outputs (models/kpct/structural/<k>, structural bundles tar, S_k test lists) and verified the S_k fallback lists against the sha256 recorded in the frozen exec_stats files (12/12 match).

Identity pilot (predictions only, no gold): replayed PK on the first 500 test quids at k01_s0 with sa_parser_replay.py; PK lists equal the frozen pred_P_k01_s0_test_ep3_tauoff_seed{0,1,2} lists for 500/500 questions (full top-50 lists, all 3 seeds). The pilot also printed fallback rates on those 500 quids (PK 0.060, PALONE 0.062, PREL 0.060, PENT 0.062). No hit was computed.

Read the frozen k01_s0 / k05_s0 structural run logs and selection_S.json (dev_sel2000 numbers of the FROZEN S_k), and know the stage-2b reference numbers of the fixed-vocabulary k01_s0 retrain (dev_sel2000 Hits@1 0.7255 / 0.7175 / 0.7200 for S seeds 0/1/2; selected 127 leaves, lr 0.05, 96 iterations).
status_at_registration.known_registered_numbers: The frozen S_k and P_k test Hits@1 (multitq_kpct_test_results.json) are known; they are the reason for this analysis, and they are not re-decided here.

inputs.generations: cached P_k test generations archived test_results/multitq/kpct/predictions/parser/test/<k>/raw_P_test_<ckpt>.jsonl.gz with the frozen checkpoints (k01_s0 ep3, k05_s0 ep1, k10_s0 ep0.5, k100 ep0.5; tau off), and the cached rewrite generations raw_P_variants_P_<k>.jsonl.gz in the R1 (6,569 variants) and R2 (2,570 variants) prediction archives (k01_s0, k05_s0, k100; k10 was never run on the rewrites -> rewrites reported at k = 1/5/100 only)
inputs.structural_parse: test: the frozen bundle parse (inputs/kpct/multitq_kpct_structural_bundles.tar, bundles/<k>/test.jsonl, sha256 verified by its index). Rewrites: the variant bundle parse rebuilt locally with the frozen robustness builder rob_build.py (unchanged; frozen executor models) because the variant bundles stayed on the GPU host; identity of the rebuilt variant RULE/S lists with the archived preds/<k>/variants_* files is checked and reported (predictions only)
inputs.fallback_lists: S_k's own test lists (preds/<k>/test_S_seed{0,1,2}.jsonl, sha256 = the frozen exec_stats fallback_source) and, for rewrites, the archived preds/<k>/variants_S_seed{0,1,2}.jsonl

part_A_parser_replay.validation: identical to the frozen pk_execute.work: pk_common.extract_json + validate_compact (else invalid_json), then check_names (relation, every mention entity, a non-null anchor must be KG names; else unknown_name). Parse validity = share of generations passing both; identical for every mode because the generation is the same.

modes.PK: kpct_executor.compact_to_parse(c, question, structural_parse = bundle parse): Parser hypothesis = rank 0, then the deduplicated structural relation hypotheses (<= 5 relations) and, per Parser mention, the alternatives of the overlapping structural mention (<= 5). Identical to the frozen P_k execution.
modes.PALONE: kpct_executor.compact_to_parse(c, question, structural_parse = None): the Parser hypothesis only (one relation-direction, one entity per Parser mention; qtype / answer type / granularity / time / anchor / order from the Parser). The executor's internal role hypotheses (topic/anchor role swap, pair order for time answers) are part of the frozen operator code and are kept unchanged in every mode.
modes.PREL (secondary): PK with each mention truncated to its first alternative (= Parser hypothesis + structural relation alternatives only)
modes.PENT (secondary): PK with the relation list truncated to its first entry (= Parser hypothesis + structural entity alternatives only)

part_A_parser_replay.execution: every mode: frozen executor Executor(k).execute(parse, question, probs='classifier') -> operators + RULE order + the 3 frozen S_k LightGBM seeds (k100: frozen full-data artefacts); per-question hit = mean over the 3 S seeds (as P_k)

fallback_variants.fb (registered handling, primary): a question falls back to S_k's own output for that seed when the generation is invalid_json, has an unknown_name, its execution raises / is invalid, or its pool is empty (tau off, as frozen). Applied identically to every mode; only empty_pool / execution failures can differ between modes.
fallback_variants.strict (separately labelled, secondary): no fallback: every question that would fall back gets an empty ranked list (scored as a miss).

metrics.parse_validity: share of questions whose generation passes validation and the KG-name check
metrics.executability: share of questions whose mode executes to a non-empty pool (= 1 - fallback frequency)
metrics.fallback_frequency: share of fallback questions, by reason (invalid_json, unknown_name, empty_pool, execution error), per mode
metrics.candidate_recall: share of ALL questions whose gold answer (official matching, multitq_eval.hit_at_k over the full pool) is in the mode's own RULE-ordered candidate pool (cap 1,000); fallback questions count as 0 (strict recall). Also reported conditional on questions executable under BOTH PK and PALONE (paired), and recall@50 of the final ranked lists (descriptive).
metrics.hits: Hits@1 primary (mean over 3 S seeds; per seed reported), Hits@10 descriptive; official evaluator multitq_eval.py
metrics.strata: descriptive Hits@1 by qtype and by answer_type (B = 1000)

identity_checks.I_A1: replayed PK (fb) top-50 lists vs the frozen pred_P_<k>_test_*_tauoff_seed{b} lists: required full-list identity >= 99.9% per seed at every k; reported for every k and seed. Below that, the k is labelled REPLAY_NOT_IDENTICAL and its numbers provisional (the PK-vs-PALONE contrast is still within-replay).
identity_checks.I_A2: replayed PK (fb) test Hits@1 vs the registered P_k Hits@1 (per-question hits CSV [id], P_k_seedN@1): difference reported; expected 0 when I_A1 = 100%.
identity_checks.I_A3: rewrites: replayed PK (fb) vs the archived pred_P_<k>_variants_* lists; and the rebuilt variant S lists vs the archived variants_S lists (identity rates reported). Below 99.5% full-list identity the rewrite numbers of that k are provisional.

contrasts.primary: D_A(k) = Hits@1(PK_fb) - Hits@1(PALONE_fb) on the full test split, k in {1, 5, 10, 100} (k = 1 is subset list k01_s0, the frozen P_1)
contrasts.secondary_strict: D_A_strict(k) = Hits@1(PK_strict) - Hits@1(PALONE_strict) (own Holm family of 4)
secondary_descriptive: PK_fb - PK_strict and PALONE_fb - PALONE_strict (what the fallback contributes)
PALONE_fb - S_k (frozen S_k test lists; is the Parser hypothesis alone better than the structural Ranker?)
PREL_fb - PALONE_fb and PENT_fb - PALONE_fb (relation vs entity alternatives)
contrasts.rewrites: for each rewrite set (R1: ORIG, P1 prefix, P2 trailing '?' removed, P3 judge-accepted paraphrase n = 569; R2: ORIG, RW judge-accepted rewrite n = 570) at k in {1, 5, 100}: Hits@1 of PK_fb, PALONE_fb, PK_strict, PALONE_strict; D_A on the variant; the drop = variant - ORIG on the same original quids for each mode, and the difference of drops PK - PALONE (paired bootstrap). Rewrite numbers are descriptive (no decision label).

decision_labels_per_k.ALTERNATIVES_HELP: D_A(k) 95% CI entirely > 0, D_A(k) >= 0.001 and Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05 (family: the 4 primary contrasts)
decision_labels_per_k.ALTERNATIVES_HURT: D_A(k) 95% CI entirely < 0, |D_A(k)| >= 0.001 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
decision_labels_per_k.summary: SUPPORTED (the structural alternatives add Hits@1 to the Parser) if ALTERNATIVES_HELP at all 4 k; PARTIAL if at 1-3 k; NOT_SUPPORTED if at none. The strict variant gets the same labels, reported separately and never substituted for the primary.

part_B_ranker_feature_group_ablation.levels: k = 1% (subset list k01_s0) and k = 5% (k05_s0); subset seeds 1/2 and k = 10/100 are not run

G_TPOS.label: temporal position / distance under the operator

part_B_ranker_feature_group_ablation.feature_groups_note: the 34 features are mtq_cand.FEATS (frozen). The 6 groups are disjoint and exhaustive (34 features). The Ranker has no explicit RULE-rank or RULE-score feature (RULE order enters only through the pool order used to break score ties); the RULE-key components are covered by the secondary composite C_RULEKEY.

C_RULEKEY.label: composite (overlapping): Ranker features that are components of the RULE lexicographic key (operator satisfied, relation rank, alternative rank, role swap, operator position, connection count)

C_TEMPORAL.label: composite (overlapping): all temporal-operator features = G_OPSAT + G_TPOS

retraining_procedure.stack: kpct_retrain_fixed_vocab.py (unchanged kpct_run.py and kpct_core.py) stage fitA with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 and the preserved vocabulary orders of the frozen checkpoints (frozen_out/<k> from code/kpct/multitq_kpct_structural_code.tgz): sector aliases, block list, silver records, full-subset classifier (E in {6, 24} by dev_sel2000 RULE Hits@1), 2-fold OOF classifier probabilities for the S training rows (cap 200 candidates per question), dev_sel2000 pools. Environment: local conda env multitq (Python 3.12.15, numpy 2.5.4, lightgbm 4.6.0, torch 2.14.1) = the environment of the original structural runs; KPCT_NPROC = 8, OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1.
retraining_procedure.ranker: frozen kpct_run.stage_trainS recipe, applied to the feature columns kept: LightGBM lambdarank (S_BASE: ndcg@1, min_data_in_leaf 100, feature_fraction 0.8, bagging 0.8/1, lambdarank_truncation_level 20), grid num_leaves {31, 63, 127} x learning_rate {0.05, 0.1} at seed 0 with early stopping (100 rounds, max 2000) on dev_sel2000 ndcg@1; selection = max dev_sel2000 Hits@1 (ties: higher ndcg@1, then grid order); seeds 0, 1, 2 retrained with the seed-0 best iteration. Run separately for the full feature set and for every ablation (each re-selected on dev_sel2000).
retraining_procedure.inference: test pools from the fitA full-subset classifier and linker (= frozen ones by vocabulary-order imposition) via K.MC.parse_info + K.build_info (frozen stage_infer path); S order = descending score, ties by RULE order; padding with PRIOR then FB (K.make_ranked). Per-question hit = mean over the 3 Ranker seeds.
retraining_procedure.why_retrained_full: free retraining is not bitwise reproducible (vocabulary order of the out-of-fold classifiers; earlier k01_s0 retrain -0.0053 [-0.0132, +0.0022] dev_sel2000, top-1 agreement 82.7-84.7%), so every ablation is compared with SA_<k>_full trained on the SAME S training rows, dev pools and test pools in the same run, never with the frozen S_k.

arms.SA_<k>_minus_<G>: retrained Ranker without group G (3 seeds), G in the 6 primary groups
arms.SA_<k>_full_hs7 (secondary, noise floor): full-feature Ranker retrained after a second fitA with PYTHONHASHSEED=7 (other OOF classifiers, hence other S training rows; same test pools); SA_full(hs0) - SA_full(hs7) is the retrain-noise reference

identity_checks.I_B1: the fitA full-subset classifier checkpoints parser_full_E{6,24}.pt equal the frozen ones (all tensors) and the test RULE lists built from the run's pools equal the frozen test_RULE.jsonl of the subset (predictions only). If not, the test pools differ from the frozen ones; all contrasts stay within-run but this is reported as a deviation.
identity_checks.I_B2: k01_s0: SA_1_full dev_sel2000 selection and Hits@1 vs the earlier fixed-vocabulary retraining check (stage 2b) (expected identical; reported).

contrasts.primary: Delta_G(k) = Hits@1(SA_k_full) - Hits@1(SA_k_minus_G) on the full test split, 6 groups x 2 k = 12 contrasts (Holm family)
secondary: the same on dev_sel2000 (descriptive; dev_sel2000 is the early-stopping and selection set, so these are optimistic)
Delta for C_RULEKEY and C_TEMPORAL (not in the Holm family)
SA_k_full - frozen S_k on test (retrain shift; descriptive, the frozen result is not changed)

decision_labels_per_cell.GROUP_NEEDED: Delta_G(k) 95% CI entirely > 0, Delta_G(k) >= 0.001 and Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05
decision_labels_per_cell.GROUP_HARMFUL: Delta_G(k) 95% CI entirely < 0, |Delta_G(k)| >= 0.001 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (removing the group helps)
decision_labels_per_cell.interpretation_guard: a GROUP_NEEDED or GROUP_HARMFUL cell whose |Delta| is below |SA_k_full(hs0) - SA_k_full(hs7)| is reported with that caveat (not relabelled).

statistic.bootstrap: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over questions, multitq_eval.paired_poisson_bootstrap, B = 2000, seed 0 (full test and rewrite sets), strata B = 1000; two-sided 95% percentile CI; two-sided p = min(1, 2 * min(P(boot <= 0), P(boot >= 0)))
statistic.single_arm_CI: Poisson(1) bootstrap of the mean hit, B = 2000, seed 0
statistic.seeds: Part A: the 3 frozen S_k seeds (per-question mean); Part B: Ranker seeds 0, 1, 2 (per-question mean); per-seed numbers reported
statistic.multiplicity: Holm within each family: A primary (4), A strict (4), B primary (12). Secondary and descriptive numbers carry unadjusted CIs and no label.

selection_discipline: Part A has no free choice (frozen generations, executor, Ranker models, tau off, fallback rule). Part B: every Ranker hyper-parameter and iteration count is chosen on dev_sel2000 only, by the frozen rule, separately per arm; the feature groups and composites are fixed in this file before any ablation is trained. Nothing is changed after a test number is read; any later addition is labelled post hoc and is not decision-relevant.
scoring_discipline: Gold answers are read only by the scoring pass, which runs after every new prediction file of the part (Part A: all modes x variants x k x splits; Part B: all arms x seeds x {dev_sel2000, test}) is listed with sha256 in a freeze file saved. Each new test file is scored once. Identity checks I_A1, I_A3, I_B1 use predictions only. dev_sel2000 gold is read during Part B training only (selection), as in the frozen recipe.

stop_rules.STOP_IDENTITY_A: if I_A1 < 99.0% at a k, Part A results for that k are reported as provisional and no label is given for that k
stop_rules.STOP_IDENTITY_B: if I_B1 fails (test RULE lists differ from the frozen ones on > 0.5% of questions), Part B is still reported (within-run contrasts) with the deviation stated

deliverables: multitq_structural_ablation_freeze_A.json / _freeze_B.json (sha256 of every new prediction file, saved before scoring)
multitq_structural_ablation_test_hits.csv.gz (per-question hits keyed by quid; and rewrite hits keyed by synthetic quid)
